name: Diona's Flower Shop
source:
Tomorrow is an especially important occasion, and you need to find the perfect bouquet of flowers. Unfortunately, you left work a bit too late at night, and now all the shops are closed.

Just when you're about to give up on the idea, you come across a flower shop that's still open... but it's a little odd?

[From [url=https://himeiro.itch.io/dionasflowershop]itch.io[/url]]
